visual_identity.silhouette_grammar: Offset concentric moonpools, uneven petal capacities, round inner droplets, hollow target halos, tapered valve fins, opposing reversible seeds, two-lobed moon gills, interlocked cascade knots, and triple-woven double braids keep every component organic and shape-readable without relying on hue.
visual_identity.spatial_grammar: Each level is a dark freeform aquatic constellation with two to five large circular basins and curved quadratic strands crossing deep negative water. Irregular basin offsets, floating plankton, boundary current arcs, and kelp commas avoid square tiles and straight industrial scaffold composition.
visual_identity.motion_grammar: Selection sends a pale scout pearl along the new curve; reversal counter-swims two beads; ordinary and double pumps ease one or paired droplets through the braid; linked pulses hand visibly from one strand to the next; closed gates radiate moon rings; mistakes recoil and close a persistent shell; success sends nested green and cyan basin blooms; and loss drains the pools behind crossed dotted seams.
visual_identity.hud_grammar: Top stage pearls use filled, active-cross, and hollow geometries; solid sun versus cutout crescent exposes tide; a curling seed exposes direction; three outlined shells close persistently on mistakes; pale rim petals expose exact capacity; inner light droplets and outer hollow beads expose load versus current target; and the lower waterline contains one exact unary droplet per remaining paid action.
